name: Rejected Reason 38 Choice
definition: Choice between a standard code or proprietary code to specify the reason why the instruction or cancellation request has a rejected status.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Standard code to specify the reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary identification of the reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.
